Lemma
[A Basis Realizing a Prescribed Orientation]

↗ lem:nonvanishing-top-form-orientation

If $n\ge 1$ and $o$ is a pointwise orientation of $M$, every $T_xM$ has a basis positively oriented for $o(x)$.

Proof

\sketch Start with any basis. If its orientation is opposite to $o(x)$, negate one member; $n\ge 1$ makes this possible.

□
